title: Terms of the Requirement Period and Release: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
**Requirement period.** The end of the requirement period for a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate comes from the state order. It is recorded on the filing as the required-through date. This holds for all six certificates.

**Release at the end of the requirement.** A release is the SR-26 sent because the requirement is completed. For every certificate it is transmitted only on or after the required-through date. The release of a certificate may be requested by the named insured or by the filed driver.

| Certificate | Who may request the release | Release SR-26 only on or after the required-through date | Source of the requirement's end |
|---|---|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | named insured or filed driver | yes | state order, recorded as the required-through date |

**Dates on either side of the boundary (hypothetical).** A certificate whose recorded required-through date is the 30th of a month:

- **On the 29th:** a release SR-26 is not transmitted.
- **On the 30th:** a release SR-26 may be transmitted, because "on or after" includes the day itself.
- **On the 31st:** a release SR-26 may be transmitted.
